name: branding-navy-fintech-modular-brand-collage
title: Navy fintech identity as a modular rounded-card collage
whatItIs: A board of rounded rectangles: a woman covering one eye with a bank card, a card on a navy tablecloth with pasta and golden cutlery, a browser bar, a large navy logo tile, a phone mock on pale blue with 'Payno Goes Wherever You Go', and a man with a phone plus balance card.
whatItMeans: Warm, human and premium; navy stays consistent while photos and props bring personality.
techniques: Arrange brand assets as a bento of rounded tiles with different content types.
Style photos with navy clothing and props so the brand colour appears in real life.
Include a plain logo tile to give the mark room to breathe.
Combine lifestyle photography with real UI cards floating over it.

vocabulary.definition: A single image summarising a brand's look.
Rounded tiles of varying size in a grid.
Choosing objects that echo brand colours.
